chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abdul Karim ibn Utbah has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, from Abdul Karim ibn Amr Al-Khath'ami, from Layth Al-Muradi, from Abdul Karim ibn Utbah Al-Hashimi.

key_terms.أبي: My father, referring to the author's father
key_terms.أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, a narrator
key_terms.أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, a narrator
key_terms.رضي الله عنه: May Allah be pleased with him
key_terms.سعد بن عبد الله: Sa'd ibn Abdullah, a prominent narrator
key_terms.عبد الكريم بن عتبة: Abdul Karim ibn Utbah, a key narrator

ai.seo_question: How is the transmission chain for Abdul Karim ibn Utbah's narrations verified in this text?
ai.summary: This passage exemplifies the rigorous methodology of *al-istidrak* (supplementing missing chains) employed by Shaykh al-Saduq to authenticate the reliability of Abdul Karim ibn Utbah, a key narrator in the Kufan school. By explicitly tracing the *isnad* from his own father through the chain of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, al-Saduq provides a concrete model of transmission continuity (*tawatur*) that reinforces the credibility of the *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih* corpus.
